title: Akiyama Mizuki — After Parties That Became A Regular Thing〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: After Parties That Became A Regular Thing（4★）
meta.Event: Someday, From the Depths of Despair

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. After hearing it, all these different ideas started popping into my head.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It even drove me towards composing an entirely new song in just one day.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (A part of me knew that we were all the “same” when I first joined this group...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But they must've been dealing with an unbearable amount of pain this whole time.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, however... I collapsed and lost consciousness before I could actually upload that song.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I knew it. There was no way she was living a healthy life back then... Hm?!)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Luckily, the housekeepers that my grandma asked to come over saw that I was in trouble and...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What isn't wrong with what you just said?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, K, you said you collapsed and lost consciousness...!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yes, I did.
By the time I woke up, I was in the hospital.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I've been worried that you'd get sick one day eating nothing but instant noodles... But it has already happened.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <No better than fasting, to be honest.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<I've been more careful lately.
I know that instant noodles alone aren't enough, so I make sure to take vitamin drinks and eat nutrient-rich foods now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <On top of that, having a housekeeper clean and cook delicious food for me has been an enormous help.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's right. You two had already met by then.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I initially met her while she was still just observing, but she was the one who discovered that I was in trouble...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That means she's the one who saved you, right?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. My grandma even said that there must be some meaning in us meeting.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hold on, Yuki, doesn't that girl go to your school?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A girl from my club that I talk to often told me her friend works as domestic help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Wait, what? You talk to people at school?
What's she like?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know how to describe her... Her name's Shizuku Hinomori, and she's a famous idol, but I don't really know about the things she does outside school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hold on a sec!
Shizuku Hinomori who used to be the front girl of Cheerful * Days?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh yeah, she quit that group, no?
I had no idea she was in the same school as Mafuyu. Nice!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That means you knew about Kanade's housekeeper too, right, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Yes, but only because Hinomori was already acquainted with her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But then, you finally met her through one of her bandmates!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That was also because Ms. Mochizuki suggested that we meet.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She's such a kind, thoughtful and gentle person.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I'm glad...
I'd like to meet her someday.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because then, I'll be able to ask her in person!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Nothing other than, “Please, keep an eye on Kanade for us!”>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Haha. Hey, let's be honest. K's eating right because of her.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Anyway, we've been on this tangent long enough. Tell us more about what happened after you two met, K, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Um... They ran tests to check for abnormalities, put me on an IV and sent me home afterward...>
